notes.title: Bug Fixes | Version 1.3
notes.content:
[p]Hey Typers,

I hope you are having fun with the game! I was made aware of a few bugs by [b]kazoo[/b] (thank you) in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/5vrRFp4aXU"]Discord community[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Twitch chat integration[/p][list][*][p]Twitch viewers can order Sodas[/p][/*][*][p]The ticket now recognises BBQ Sauce order through Twitch[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Alt-tabbing out of the game now does not lose focus of the text input field[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Have a nice,[/p][p]~ Jiri[/p]
